name: io.github.swantron/spendtron
title: spendtron
description: GitHub Actions cost: check any workflow file for waste (no key), or read your per-job cost report.

tools.name: check_actions_cost
tools.description: Reads the saved spendtron report for this API key: workflows priced per job at current GitHub runner rates, plus corroborated workflow changes. Does not scan GitHub itself. Open /report to build or refresh the sample.

tools.name: check_workflow_yaml
tools.description: Static cost review of one GitHub Actions workflow file: duplicate push and pull_request runs, missing concurrency, path filters and timeouts, macOS and larger runners, wide matrices, frequent schedules, missing dependency caches. Returns findings and, where safe, a patched copy. No API key needed. Nothing is stored.

yaml.description: The full contents of one file from .github/workflows

visibility.description: Repository visibility; standard runners are free on public repositories
